data.name: Nawshad
data.gender_notes: Nawshad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'nawshada', meaning 'to guide'. It signifies a person who provides light or guidance. The name Nawshad carries the meaning “Light of guidance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nawshad usually hope their child will grow to embody light of guidance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Nawshad is often associated with Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), who is considered the ultimate light of guidance.
data.etymology: Nawshad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light of guidance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nawshad total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_urdu.name: نوشاد
in_urdu.meaning: نام کا مطلب ہے خوشحالی اور فراوانی
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام نوشاد کا مطلب ہے خوشحالی اور فراوانی، یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے اچھا کھانا یا شادابی۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ سعادت و خوشی کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नौशाद
in_hindi.meaning: नाम का अर्थ है सुख और समृद्धि
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम नौशाद का अर्थ है सुख और समृद्धि, यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है अच्छा भोजन या समृद्धि। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है क्योंकि यह सुख और समृद्धि की प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: نوشاد

in_english.name: Nawshad
in_english.meaning: Derived from Arabic, meaning good food or happiness
in_english.long_meaning: The name Nawshad originates from Arabic roots, specifically from 'nawsh' which refers to a type of good food or delicacy. It symbolizes happiness, joy, and abundance. Although not directly mentioned in the Quran, the concept of enjoying good food is referenced in several hadiths and Quranic verses. Historically, the name has been used in various Muslim cultures to signify prosperity and well-being. In contemporary times, Nawshad remains a popular name among Muslim communities worldwide.

This reflects the honor and responsibility bestowed upon individuals with this name, to lead and guide others in the right direction.

As bearers of this name, individuals are encouraged to embody the qualities of being a guiding light and sources of wisdom, support, and compassion for those around them in their spiritual journey. This can manifest in both personal relationships and in communities, inspiring individuals to provide guidance and support to others in their quest for knowledge and enlightenment.
